required_extensions: mysqli (suggested when required by the existing application connection layer)
notes: Schema-only baseline; seed files contain no customer records or credentials.
invitados_listado_mesa_bkp and invitados_pagos remain in the source snapshot but are excluded pending legacy/feature ownership review.
Historical AUTO_INCREMENT table options and the Hostinger-specific trigger DEFINER were removed.

utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci was minimally mapped to utf8mb4_unicode_ci and latin1_swedish_nopad_ci to latin1_swedish_ci for MySQL/MariaDB portability; other snapshot charset and collation choices are preserved.
The required technical seed uses only defaults confirmed by includes/plan_config.php; optional starter content contains editable demo content.
